annotations.title: Favorite a game or follow a creator

description: Toggle the authenticated user's favorite/follow. Provide gameId to favorite a game, or promoterId to follow a creator (the same Following list the /promoters Following tab reads). Calling twice removes it. Returns { success, favorited }. Acts on the API key owner's own library. Available on every tier, but agents that make many calls per task burn through a free-tier daily quota quickly. Email colin@kineticist.com for a higher ceiling.

gameId.description: Game UUID. Accepts both the raw UUID and the 'gm_'-prefixed form that get_game_details returns (prefix stripped automatically).

promoterId.description: Kineticist promoter (creator) UUID to follow/unfollow. Provide this OR gameId, not both.
